extDescription.message: Select a Turkish word and see its meaning from the TDK dictionary instantly. Handles inflected words too. No data collection.

tagline.message: The TDK dictionary, without leaving the page

dblclickHint.message: Shows the meaning of any word you double-click. Needs access to all sites to turn on.

shortcutLine.message: Shortcut: select a word and press $KEY$. Also in the right-click menu.

menuLine.message: Select a word and right-click: “Look up in TDK with Anlamca”.

menuLookup.message: Look up in TDK with Anlamca: “%s”

commandLookup.message: Look up the selected word in TDK

notFound.message: Not found in the TDK dictionary.

offline.message: TDK isn't answering right now. Try again in a bit, or use one of the links below.

privacyLine.message: Only the word you look up is sent to TDK. Nothing else is collected.
